title: Lucky Thirteen Kong Blood Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Lucky Thirteen’s famous Kong Blood is a deliciously sweet and refreshing strawberry soda flavour, with soft, succulent strawberries on the inhale falling away to a cool and bubbly soda thanks to a subtle streak of menthol. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend fuses fantastic flavour and cloud production, while the high nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter kits and pod devices. Perfect for newer ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts.
